admin.exTopo.vpnHelp: Enable the VPN gateway for this variant's laboratory. Add a connection to a device to make it reachable.
admin.exTopo.internetHelp: Enable the Internet gateway for this variant's laboratory. Add a connection to a device to use it.
admin.exTopo.dhcpHelp: Automatically assign IP addresses on this enabled network. Disable it when addresses are configured manually.
admin.exTopo.gatewayAlreadyConnected: This gateway already has a connection. Remove that connection before attaching another device.
admin.exTopo.deviceNameHelp: Unique device name in this variant. Use lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens; no spaces.
admin.exTopo.deviceTypeHelp: Choose a runtime device or a forwarding device. Switches and hubs have no image or environment variables.
admin.exTopo.type.containerHelp: Isolated application with its own image, network interfaces, and environment variables.
admin.exTopo.type.vmHelp: Separate virtual system with its own image and network interfaces.
admin.exTopo.type.switchHelp: Each connection to the switch automatically creates a virtual port. Interfaces are not configured manually.
admin.exTopo.type.hubHelp: Each connection to the hub uses an automatic virtual port in the shared network segment.
admin.exTopo.imageHelp: Image reference used to start this container. Leave empty if it is not configured yet.
admin.exTopo.resourcesHelp: Optional CPU and memory requests and limits. A request cannot exceed its limit.
admin.exTopo.cpuRequestHelp: For example, 250m is one quarter of a core.
admin.exTopo.interfacesHelp: Network interfaces on this device. Add one for each connection point you need.
admin.ex.val.interfacesRequired: A container or virtual machine must have at least one interface.
admin.exTopo.ifaceNameHelp: Name of this network interface, for example eth0.
admin.exTopo.macHelp: Optional hardware address. Leave empty to assign it automatically.
admin.exTopo.ipTypeHelp: How this interface receives its IP address: static, DHCP, preset DHCP or none.
admin.exTopo.ip.staticHelp: Set one or more fixed addresses and, optionally, a gateway.
admin.exTopo.ip.dhcpHelp: The device image runs its own DHCP client and configures its interface.
admin.exTopo.ip.dhcpPresetHelp: The platform obtains and applies an address when the image has no DHCP client.
admin.exTopo.securityPresetHelp: Runtime capabilities available inside this device. The default is the basic profile.
admin.exTopo.security.defaultHelp: No extra privileges. Same capabilities as Basic.
admin.exTopo.security.basicHelp: Run an ordinary service without extra capabilities.
admin.exTopo.security.serviceHelp: Allows a service to bind privileged ports.
admin.exTopo.security.netHelp: Allows network diagnostics and configuration tools.
admin.exTopo.security.debugHelp: Networking tools plus process debugging capabilities.
admin.exTopo.canvasHint: Drag nodes to arrange them. To connect, select two nodes in turn; connections can also be edited below.
admin.exTopo.canvasSelectSecond: Select a second node to connect.
admin.exTopo.ip.noneHelp: Keep the interface at layer 2 without assigning an IP address.
admin.exTopo.addressesHelp: One address is required for static IP, for example 10.0.0.2/24.
admin.exTopo.routesHelp: Optional routes to other networks through a next-hop IP.
admin.exTopo.routeDstHelp: Network in CIDR notation, for example 10.1.0.0/16.
admin.exTopo.routeViaHelp: Next-hop IP of the same family as the destination network.
admin.exTopo.gatewayHelp: Optional gateway address for a static IP configuration.
admin.exTopo.externalHelp: Expose this device over HTTP or HTTPS. Port and protocol are needed only when access is enabled.
admin.exTopo.portHelp: Port inside the device to expose, from 1 to 65535.
admin.exTopo.protocolHelp: Choose HTTP or HTTPS for this exposed service.

admin.exTask.flag.title: Flag
admin.exTask.flag.help: General rule: use ICE{...} without spaces. Without a device, supply one flag; with a device, supply multiple candidates or use automatic generation.
admin.exTask.flag.fixedHelp: An exact flag value used without changes.
admin.exTask.flag.pasteHintHelp: Paste a list into a flag field, one flag per line.
admin.exTask.flag.pasteDescription: Review the flags and choose their shared type.
admin.exTask.flag.pasteTarget: The first valid flag will replace flag
admin.exTask.flag.pasteStaticLimit: Without a linked device, you can paste only one fixed flag.
admin.exTask.flag.templateRules: Each placeholder generates one character. Brackets can list characters, ranges and placeholders; other characters remain literal. ICE{...} is required.
admin.exTask.flag.templateExclusionRules: Inside one bracketed set, ^ separates allowed characters from excluded ones: [\d^13] means any digit except 1 and 3; [a-z^aeiou] means any lowercase letter except vowels. Exclusions must belong to the allowed set, and the result cannot be empty.
admin.exTask.flag.templateCodes:
\d — digit 0–9
\l — lowercase Latin letter a–z
\u — uppercase Latin letter A–Z
admin.exTask.flag.weightHelp: Candidates are chosen in proportion to their possible outputs.
admin.exTask.flag.weak: Few random combinations — this flag may be easy to guess.
admin.exTask.flag.overlap: This fixed flag can also be generated by a template.
admin.exTask.flag.staticHelp: Without a linked device, exactly one fixed flag is required before publishing.
admin.exTask.flag.staticTypeHelp: Only a fixed flag is available now. Other types appear after you add a container to the topology and link it to this task.
admin.exTask.flag.unlinkedTypeHelp: Only a fixed flag is available now. Other types appear after you link this task to a container in the topology.
admin.exTask.flag.staticCount: After unlinking the device, keep exactly one fixed flag.
admin.exTask.removeDescription: The stage will be removed from every variant.
admin.exFiles.dropHere: Drop the file to attach it to this stage
admin.exTask.flag.semantics0: No values — a random flag is generated at deploy time
admin.exTask.flag.semantics1: One entry — that entry is used
admin.exTask.flag.semanticsN: Several values — one is picked at random at deploy time
admin.exTask.linkedDeviceHelp: Optionally send this task's flag to a container in this variant.
admin.exTask.deviceFlagVarHelp: Environment variable that receives the flag in the selected device.
admin.ex.val.deviceFlagVarRequired: Enter the environment variable for the flag.
admin.ex.val.deviceFlagVarConflict: This variable is already used by a regular environment variable or another task flag.
admin.ex.val.linkedDeviceUnavailable: Select a container from this variant's topology.

admin.exPh.kindHelp: Choose whether to insert a subnet, IP address, or external link.
admin.exPh.iprefHelp: Network used to form the address: VPN, internet, or manual octets.
admin.exPh.octetsHelp: The first three parts of a static IPv4 address, for example 10.0.0.
admin.exPh.lastOctetHelp: The final IPv4 address part, an integer from 0 to 255.
admin.exPh.showMaskHelp: Append the network prefix length to the inserted IP address.
admin.exPh.deviceHelp: Device with external access enabled whose link is inserted into the description.

admin.events.lifecycle.help.not_publishe: Moderators have access, but the event is not shown to participants yet.

admin.events.lifecycle.help.withdrawn: The event is no longer public; moderator access continues until archiving.
admin.events.lifecycle.help.archived: The subdomain access window has ended and the event is archived.
